_readme: Keyed by MLB player id (the number in statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/people/<id>). Required: total (dollars) and either years or start+end. Optional: aav (defaults to total/years), seasons (a map of year -> dollars, used for the per-season AAV button; defaults to a flat aav across start..end), note (shown under the summary). The three entries below are starter examples entered from memory: verify them, then replace or extend.

660271.name: Shohei Ohtani
660271.note: Most of the deal is deferred, so the luxury-tax value is about $46.1M a year. Per-season figures here are the flat $70M AAV.
